origin.reference: Herakles, expansion-design pass 2026-09-06 (F-6, C-0, E1, E3)

rationale: E3, the exchangeability null. Against a hashed target the score of ANY candidate is Binomial(L,1/2)/L: mean 0.5, sd sqrt(1/(4L)). This template draws exactly what the frozen baseline draws and is declared, in advance, to carry NO effect on the bits axis. Its purpose is to give the detector battery a case whose correct answer is known: any D1-D6 signal attributed to bits on worlds drawn from it is an instrument defect, a seeding fault, or a leak. It is byte-identical in space to bitstring.uniform.v0 by design; the template_id is the declaration. Admission is the operator's act.
